description: SIP-MOSP finds the exact Pareto set of paths with many threads that do not wait for each other (*asynchronous*). Search workers expand labels from private queues, each with its own objective order. They prune children against *snapshots*: published, read-only copies of a state's frontier and of the goal frontier. One update worker owns each state; it alone changes that state's exact frontier, checks each candidate again if its snapshot is old, and publishes the next version. Snapshots are a sorted, indexed base plus a short list of recent additions, so most checks are fast and the result does not depend on thread timing.

papers.authors: Xiaoqing Xu, Ning Zhang, Liuyihui Qian, Xiaojun Liu, Juan Wu, Hong Tang
papers.title: Asynchronous Parallel Search for Exact Multi-Objective Shortest Paths with Versioned Frontier Snapshots and Indexed Dominance Pruning
